findings.F1: Learner error on pronoun position has incorrect and correct sentences swapped.
findings.F2: Antonym switch-on-phrv is listed among sense 1 synonyms.
findings.F3: Sense 3 (make someone bored or uninterested) is wrongly labeled formal.
findings.F4: Sense 1 definition is causative only, but its grammar and the oven example include the intransitive use (a machine stops).
findings.F5: Sense 1 definition omits the frequent use with settings and features (notifications, Wi-Fi).
findings.F6: disable-v is not a true synonym of sense 1.
findings.F7: The open/close versus turn off trap is stated in both learner_errors and adaptation.false_friends.
findings.F8: The verb/noun stress contrast is stated in both pronunciation.notes and adaptation.pronunciation.
